name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina Volkov's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly during her engineering studies in Moscow, where a university project involving vehicle dynamics sparked a lifelong fascination. She rapidly transitioned from simulations to hands-on experience, volunteering at local racing events and quickly proving her organizational abilities. Her meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach soon caught the eye of a budding Formula 3 team, where she honed her race management skills. 

Volkov believes a sporting director must be both a strategist and a diplomat. She is known for her data-driven decision-making, combined with an ability to foster strong relationships between engineers, drivers, and pit crew. Her reputation for calm, collected leadership under pressure has been crucial in turning around struggling teams, making her a sought-after asset in the paddock. At Erebus Motorsport, she aims to integrate cutting-edge telemetry with traditional racecraft, ensuring every tactical decision is both informed and decisive.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Irina is of average height, with a composed demeanor that reflects her strategic mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in digital meetings.
Insists on brewing her own strong black tea every afternoon.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on the table when deep in thought.
